mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Reviews (PRODUCT_IDX, USER_IDX, USER_NAME, REVIEW,RATING, IS_HIDE,REG_DATE,Item_Idx) VALUES (#{productIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{userName}, #{review}, #{rating}, #{isHide}, NOW(), #{itemIdx})
INSERT INTO ReviewImage ( review_idx, review_img) VALUES (#{reviewIdx}, #{reviewImg} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_Idx AS reviewIdx, r.product_Idx AS productIdx, r.user_Idx AS userIdx, r.user_Name AS userName, r.review AS review, r.Rating AS rating, r.is_Hide AS isHide, r.Reg_Date AS regDate, r.item_Idx AS itemIdx, items.color AS color, items.size AS size FROM Reviews r INNER JOIN OrderItems items ON r.item_Idx = items.item_Idx WHERE r.user_Idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY r.Reg_Date DESC
SELECT review_Idx AS reviewIdx, product_Idx AS productIdx, item_Idx AS itemIdx, review, Rating AS rating FROM Reviews WHERE review_Idx = #{reviewIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE Reviews SET review = #{review}, Rating = #{rating}, Reg_Date = NOW() WHERE review_Idx = #{reviewIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT review_Img_Idx AS reviewImgIdx, review_Idx AS reviewIdx, review_Img AS reviewImg FROM ReviewImage WHERE review_Idx = #{reviewIdx}

SELECT r.review_Idx AS reviewIdx, r.product_Idx AS productIdx, r.user_Name AS userName, r.review, r.Rating AS rating, r.Reg_Date AS regDate, r.item_Idx AS itemIdx, oi.color AS color, oi.size AS size FROM Reviews r INNER JOIN OrderItems oi ON r.item_Idx = oi.item_Idx WHERE r.product_Idx = #{productIdx} AND r.is_Hide = 0 ORDER BY r.Reg_Date DESC
